Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp System time of event creation.
ContextProcessId
UPID of process originating this event.
TargetFileName
The resulting file name that was downloaded
Size
Size of the egressing file in bytes.
ShannonEntropy
Values in units of Shannons, or the number of bits per byte required to optimally encode any word of a given message in 8-bit words.
Represented as a positive integer from 0-1000 where the higher the value is correlates to a higher relative Shannon entropy.
AuthenticationId
Values:
INVALID_LUID (0)
NETWORK_SERVICE (996)
LOCAL_SERVICE (997)
SYSTEM (999)
RESERVED_LUID_MAX (1000)
FileEcpBitmask
Values:
ECP_SRV_OPEN (0x00000001)
ECP_CS_SENSOR_OPEN (0x00000002)
